newsitem.title: USA: Bomb in holiday wrap injures California lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Bomb in holiday wrap injures California lawyer.

text.p: A California attorney was seriously injured on Monday by a bomb that was wrapped up like a holiday present, the FBI and local authorities said.
The attorney found the package outside his office in Santa Cruz, said George Grotz, FBI spokesman in San Francisco.
"He took that into his office and proceeded to open it up, and as he did so, it exploded," Grotz said.
Police in Santa Cruz would not identify the victim, but local television and radio stations identified the man as Jack Jacobson, a family law and divorce attorney.
Police said the victim was badly injured in the blast, with severe damage to both of his hands and his torso. No one else was injured, police said.
The victim was airlifted to the Stanford University Medical Centre, which would not discuss his condition.
Police said they have yet to determine what type of explosive was used but said the device was powerful, spreading shrapnel over a wide area.
The Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco and Firearms and local authorities planned to conduct a joint investigation into the incident, police said.
